notes.title: Over The Phone Update
notes.notes:
Over The Phone's release is approaching quickly; shooting for mid-late February.  Price will be $2.99.  If you enjoyed Drinks With Abbey, please check this out too.  The trailer is just the beginning of the game.  At the end, you can click a video link to see the outcome of each choice.  If it looks interesting, please wishlist on the Steam page.  Thanks to everyone who has supported me over the past year - with donations, feedback, and just playing this game.

Interactive trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1Mfya57tfak
Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1533720/Over_The_Phone/
